footnote_text: Represents an award of restricted stock units ("RSUs"). On October 28, 2026, the Company filed a Current Report on Form 8-K under Item 5.02 disclosing that Mr. Ball would receive a $2,400,000 RSU award as consideration for his service as Interim Chief Financial Officer. For administrative purposes, the compensation arrangement was implemented as an annual base salary of $100,000 and an RSU award valued at $2,300,000. The RSUs reported herein reflect the $2,300,000 equity portion of the arrangement and vest on November 6, 2027, with the final number of vested RSUs subject to pro-ration based on Mr. Ball's actual service period as Interim Chief Financial Officer during the one-year vesting period.
Each restricted stock unit converts into one share of DHI common stock.
These shares were surrendered to issuer to cover tax obligations of the 6,198 shares of DHI common stock issued upon the vesting of the restricted stock units awarded November 8, 2023.
